Job Category: CSD
Job Type: Full Time
Job Location: Navi Mumbai
Job Summary
We are looking for a highly skilled Network Engineer (L3) who will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and troubleshooting enterprise-level network infrastructure. The candidate must have strong hands-on experience in routing, switching, firewall, VPN, WAN, LAN, wireless, and network security, along with the ability to handle escalated (L3) issues and provide long-term solutions.
The Network Engineer L3 will work closely with internal IT teams, security teams, vendors, and customers to ensure high availability, performance, and security of network systems.

Job Description – Network Engineer L3

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle L3 escalation support for complex network issues and outages.
  • Design, configure, and maintain LAN/WAN infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot advanced routing and switching issues in production networks.
  • Implement and manage network security solutions including firewall rules, VPNs, and ACLs.
  • Configure and manage routers, switches, and firewalls (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Juniper, etc.).
  • Manage BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLAN, STP, HSRP/VRRP, NAT, QoS configurations.
  • Perform network performance monitoring and capacity planning.
  • Configure and troubleshoot site-to-site VPN and remote access VPN.
  • Maintain and support wireless networks (Access Points, Controllers).
  • Work on network upgrades, migrations, and deployment projects.
  • Ensure compliance with security policies and best practices.
  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers for issue resolution.
  • Prepare network documentation such as topology diagrams, configuration backups, and SOPs.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call support and provide root cause analysis (RCA) for incidents.
  • Automate routine network tasks using scripts/tools (preferred).

Required Skills

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VLAN, Subnetting

Expertise in Routing & Switching

Hands-on experience with:

Cisco / Juniper / Fortinet / Palo Alto devices (any preferred)

Good understanding of:

Firewall policies, IDS/IPS, VPN tunnels

Experience with network monitoring tools:

SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, Zabbix or similar

Knowledge of ITIL process (Incident/Change/Problem management)
